declared: 2026-11-20T10:10Z, before any candidate ran under this contract (a pre-contract smoke run of closure.py on the dev traces was made at about 10:00Z and is disclosed in the ledger)
machine: one container, same run, same Python process per family; Python 3, no third-party packages
pareto_rule: candidate A is removed only if some B is no worse on every declared objective on every dev input and strictly better on one. Wall time: medians within 10% or overlapping [p25,p75] count as a tie. Correctness is a hard constraint: an incorrect candidate is removed whatever its other numbers.

a_closure.task: after every append, report the newly derived terms of viewC (r=0, identity chain, live color test)
a_closure.reference: earliest-prefix map by Knuth's superior-function algorithm (closure.earliest), itself checked against naive scratch at sampled prefixes

b1_front.task: exact Pareto front (minimize) of a static option set
b1_front.inputs: per-run cold vectors [wall_us, cpu_us, peak_tree_kib, maxrss_kib] of each campaign

b2_joint.task: front of additive joint plans, one driver per task, costs [cold_p50_us, cpu_p50_us, failures, warm_p50_us]
b2_joint.reference: brute force over all plans where <= 100,000 plans; cross-agreement of exact candidates beyond

b3_select.task: pick one option per weight vector

c_stop.task: pick the weighted-sum-best joint plan from a lexicographic plan stream

d_incremental.task: front after every append of a stream of per-run records

e_weights.task: reach every front point by a scalarization and a parameter set
e_weights.supported_test: reached by weighted sum on the denominator-60 simplex grid (an under-approximation of supportedness)

f_binding.task: resolve each reference of each idol-lib v2 definition to candidate bindings

objectives.lexically_unsound_edges: min (an edge to a nested binding outside the referrer's enclosing chain)

f_binding.not_an_objective: reach of jq shape is reported, never used to select
f_binding.correctness: UNMEASURED: no compiler-resolved bindings are reachable here

decision_data.disqualified: idol-map (CLAIMS.md E3) carries color disqualified and is filtered before any front

adversarial_controls: a duplicate premise inside each record
records colored disqualified (4) and records at level 1 > r
lean: survivors get a Lean proof where feasible, built cold by proof/check.sh, no sorry, axioms within propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound
